   "source": [
    "## Overview (26/01/2026)\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook is for the purpose of testing/demonstrating the code in aux_funcs/DRT.py."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "cca39aaf",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import os, sys\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    import pySIMsalabim as sim\n",
    "except ImportError: # add parent directory to sys.path if pySIMsalabim is not installed\n",
    "    sys.path.append('..')\n",
    "    import pySIMsalabim as sim\n",
    "from pySIMsalabim.aux_funcs import DRT as drt\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "TESTED_LATEST_VERSION = 0.10"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "d2b7d030",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Define a function to give a gaussian distribution of lifetimes about a central lifetime tau on a logarithmic scale\n",
    "def log_gaussian(tau, mu, sig):\n",
    "    return 1/(sig*np.sqrt(2*np.pi))*np.exp(-(np.log10(tau/mu))**2/(2*sig**2))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "376f8550",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Capacitive and Inductive Curve Test"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "44f31ec6",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Generate an array of time values of length N\n",
    "t_min = 1e-10\n",
    "t_max = 1e2\n",
    "time = np.geomspace(t_min, t_max, 140)\n",
    "time_ppd = int(np.log10(t_max/t_min))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Generate array of tau values of length M such that tau_ppd ~ time_ppd (ppd - points per decade)\n",
    "d_t = [time[i+1] - time[i] for i in range(len(time)-1)]\n",
    "d_t_min = np.min(d_t)\n",
    "d_T = time[-1] - time[0]\n",
    "tau_min = d_t_min/np.pi   # Selected based on Nyquist spacing\n",
    "tau_max = d_T/(2*np.pi)   # Selected based on Nyquist spacing\n",
    "tau_dec = int(np.log10(d_T/tau_min))\n",
    "tau_values = np.geomspace(tau_min, tau_max, len(time))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Generate the analytic curve\n",
    "gaussian_coeffs = [5, -3, 2]\n",
    "gaussian_peaks = [1e-6, 1e-4, 1e-1] # These now correspond to when decay events begin\n",
    "analytic_U = np.sum([gaussian_coeffs[i]*log_gaussian(tau_values, gaussian_peaks[i], 0.2) for i in range(len(gaussian_coeffs))], axis=0)\n",
    "analytic_y = drt.predict_y_model(time, analytic_U, tau_values) + 20\n",
    "analytic_y_scaled = (analytic_y - analytic_y.min())/(analytic_y.max() - analytic_y.min())\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot the data \n",
    "plt.plot(time, analytic_y)\n",
    "plt.xscale('log')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('$t$ [$\\\\text{s}$]')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('$y$ (scaled)')\n",
    "plt.title(\"Analytic Capacitive Curve\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4612914a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Linear Fit"

  },

   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [

     "output_type": "display_data"

   ],
   "source": [
    "# Try linear fit\n",
    "linear_fit = drt.linear_fit(time, analytic_y)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot fit results\n",
    "drt.plot_y(time, linear_fit.y_model, y_data=analytic_y)\n",
    "drt.plot_U(linear_fit.tau, linear_fit.U_norm, tau_values, analytic_U/np.sum(analytic_U), plot_title='Normalised DRT')"
   ]
  },

   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "fits = drt.checkerboard_fit(time, analytic_y)\n",
    "cb_fit = fits[-1]"

   "source": [
    "drt.plot_y(time, cb_fit.y_model, analytic_y)\n",
    "drt.plot_U(cb_fit.tau, cb_fit.U, tau_analytic=tau_values, U_analytic=analytic_U)"
   ]

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0f2a845e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Analytic and Capacitive"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "b2f0a5ca",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Define a function to give a gaussian distribution of lifetimes about a central lifetime tau on a logarithmic scale\n",
    "def log_gaussian(tau, mu, sig):\n",
    "    return 1/(sig*np.sqrt(2*np.pi))*np.exp(-(np.log10(tau/mu))**2/(2*sig**2))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "4e81a8b1",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Generate an array of time values of length N\n",
    "t_min = 1e-10\n",
    "t_max = 1e2\n",
    "time = np.geomspace(t_min, t_max, 1000)\n",
    "time_ppd = int(np.log10(t_max/t_min))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Generate array of tau values of length M such that tau_ppd ~ time_ppd (ppd - points per decade)\n",
    "tau_min = t_min/np.pi   # Selected based on Nyquist spacing\n",
    "tau_max = t_max/(2*np.pi)   # Selected based on Nyquist spacing\n",
    "tau_dec = int(np.log10(tau_max/tau_min))\n",
    "tau_values = np.geomspace(t_min/np.pi, t_max/(2*np.pi), tau_dec*time_ppd)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Generate the analytic curve\n",
    "gaussian_coeffs = [5, 3, 2]\n",
    "gaussian_peaks = [1e-6, 1e-4, 1e-1] # These now correspond to when decay events begin\n",
    "analytic_U = np.sum([gaussian_coeffs[i]*log_gaussian(tau_values, gaussian_peaks[i], 0.2) for i in range(len(gaussian_coeffs))], axis=0)\n",
    "analytic_y = drt.predict_y_model(time, analytic_U, tau_values)\n",
    "analytic_y_scaled = (analytic_y - analytic_y.min())/(analytic_y.max() - analytic_y.min())\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot the data \n",
    "plt.plot(time, analytic_y)\n",
    "plt.xscale('log')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('$t$ [$\\\\text{s}$]')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('$y$ (scaled)')\n",
    "plt.title(\"Analytic Capacitive Curve\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
